What is the difference between an instance method, a static method and a class method?

Supplied answer
An instance method takes self and works on one object's data. A class method is decorated with
@classmethod, takes cls, and works on class-level data (often used as an alternative constructor). A
static method is decorated with @staticmethod, takes neither self nor cls, and is just a helper function
kept inside the class for organisation.
